title: Ball
statementMd:
$*N*$ ladies attend the ball in the King's palace. Every lady can be described with three values: beauty, intellect and richness. King's Master of Ceremonies knows that ladies are very special creatures. If some lady understands that there is other lady at the ball which is more beautiful, smarter and more rich, she can jump out of the window. He knows values of all ladies and wants to find out how many probable self-murderers will be on the ball. Lets denote beauty of the $*i*$-th lady by $*B*_{*i*}$, her intellect by $*I*_{*i*}$ and her richness by $*R*_{*i*}$. Then $*i*$-th lady is a probable self-murderer if there is some $*j*$-th lady that $*B*_{*i*} < *B*_{*j*}, *I*_{*i*} < *I*_{*j*}, *R*_{*i*} < *R*_{*j*}$. Find the number of probable self-murderers.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $*N*$ ($1 ≤ *N* ≤ 500000$). The second line contains $*N*$ integer numbers $*B*_{*i*}$, separated by single spaces. The third and the fourth lines contain sequences $*I*_{*i*}$ and $*R*_{*i*}$ in the same format. It is guaranteed that $0 ≤ *B*_{*i*}, *I*_{*i*}, *R*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$.

## Output

Output the answer to the problem.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
$*N*$ 位女士参加了王宫中的舞会。每位女士都可以用三个值来描述：美貌、智慧和财富。国王的司仪知道，女士们都是非常特殊的生物。如果某位女士发现舞会上有另一位女士比自己更美丽、更聪明且更富有，她就可能会跳窗自尽。他知道所有女士的各项数值，并希望找出舞会上有多少位可能自杀的女士。令第 $*i*$ 位女士的美貌为 $*B*_{*i*}$，智慧为 $*I*_{*i*}$，财富为 $*R*_{*i*}$。如果存在某位第 $*j*$ 位女士满足 $*B*_{*i*} < *B*_{*j*}, *I*_{*i*} < *I*_{*j*}, *R*_{*i*} < *R*_{*j*}$，那么第 $*i*$ 位女士就是一位可能自杀者。请计算可能自杀者的数量。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*N*$（$1 ≤ *N* ≤ 500000$）。第二行包含 $*N*$ 个整数 $*B*_{*i*}$，整数之间用单个空格分隔。第三行和第四行以相同格式分别包含序列 $*I*_{*i*}$ 和 $*R*_{*i*}$。保证 $0 ≤ *B*_{*i*}, *I*_{*i*}, *R*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$。

## 输出格式

输出题目的答案。
</statement>
